findings: 2026-11-05: drafted for Mathematics 11 Unit 12 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: In the book's graph for Example 13(b), the point (3, 6) is drawn as a solid dot on an unbroken line, although g is not defined at x = 3 and the text says there is a break in the graph there. The point (3, 6) must be an open circle (a hole), as in our drawing.

Book correction: The book's solution calls the graph "figure (iii)", but the figure carries no number. In that graph the end of the left piece at (3, 2) is drawn as a solid dot; since f(3) = 7, the point (3, 2) is not on the graph and must be an open circle, as in our drawing. The solid dot belongs at (3, 7) only.
